# Skills

<!-- Generated by tools/build_catalog.py - do not edit by hand. -->

77 skills in 16 categories. Every skill is a standard Agent Skill and works in Claude Code, Google Antigravity, Devin, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, Codex and Gemini CLI. Install a category with `python tools/install.py --agent <agent> --plugin <category>`; see the [main README](../README.md#install) for every option.
